name: @turboslide/realtime-worker
description: The realtime Worker (docs/CLOUDFLARE.md 3.1, 3.6.2): one Cloudflare Worker, turboslide-realtime, holding one SQLite backed Durable Object per deck over hibernating WebSockets as the channel and the presence of the `do` tier, with the accounts database D1 bound to it and reached by the Vercel function through its bearer routes. The pure admission comes from @turboslide/realtime/room-core; the Vercel app keeps every page, the store and the version log. src/index.ts is the router (the ticket and bearer checks, /health, the D1 and control routes) and src/deck-room.ts the object.
